_comment: tb/vis-water-sky group 2 (coordinator 1 Nov: shared fix; judges across Cloudreach read 'a flat uniform lawn' / evenly scattered ground cover). On: the turf shader (cloudreach_turf.gdshaderinc) mixes broad dry (straw-olive) and lush (deep green) patches roughly 60-90 m across from one smooth world-space field, and cloudreach_look.gd thins the grass tufts to keep_dry on the dry patches by the same field, so tall blades cluster on the lush ground with open sunlit grass between. Visual only: no collider, route, scatter bake or save change. Preview --cloudreach-cluster-candidate.
